title: compiler.Validate
description: Validate loads the declaration and the registry, runs the semantic checks and returns every fault it finds. It writes no file.

title: buildidentity.Current
description: Current reads the build identity from the Go build metadata. Apply and the version command use this one source.

title: compiler.DetectDrift
description: DetectDrift refuses while a journal is pending, reads the record, and compares every generated file and recorded input with the disk.

title: compiler.Reconcile
description: Reconcile reads the declaration, the registry and the record, and returns the plan. It writes nothing.

title: main.runRegistryInspect
description: runRegistryInspect answers for the component a person names, as text. It has no structured output yet.

title: main.runRegistrySearch
description: runRegistrySearch keeps the components that match the -provides, -requires and -slot filters, in name order, as a table.
